verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to define rules that automatically trigger actions on events. Webhooks only let developers observe file events (comments, new versions), and any resulting action must be built externally, which makes them a developer building block. The MCP 'custom rules' are AI guidance instructions rather than event triggers, and plugins run only when a user invokes them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
